what: Fixed benchmark of SIMULATED store clips (browser simulator copy, scripts/bench/render_clip.mjs). Splits are by scenario seed and never overlap. dev and test are generator 1 (kept as regression sets); dev2 and checkpoint are generator 2 (harder scenes, cameras by aisle, camera pass, nominal planogram).

train.use: training data only. 1000:1240 are the scenes the sim_sku detector was trained and validated on (make sku-data). Render any seed in this range with render_clip.mjs or scripts/train/render_synth.mjs.

scratch.use: not part of the benchmark. 5001 is the clip of the first end to end run (make sku-clip-door); it was looked at while building the pipeline.

dev.use: regression set (generator 1). Was the tuning set of rounds 0 to 5: make bench-dev

test.use: regression set (generator 1). Was run once as the held-out set on commit 9068c1a: make bench-test

dev2.use: the tuning set from 2026-10-05 on: make bench-dev2. Tune and diagnose here, never on checkpoint clips.

checkpoint.use: held-out pool of 30 seeds, rendered 6 at a time: `.venv/bin/python scripts/bench/render_split.py checkpoint --next 6` renders the next 6 unused seeds and marks them used. A batch is scored once (`python -m bree.sim.bench checkpoint --stress`), by a pipeline that was not tuned on it. Nobody looks at the frames or the truth of an unused seed.
